label: Illumination source withdrawal and alternative input controls
paraphrase: Declared finite scenarios of one receiver have response 3 with solar input, zero when that emission is withdrawn or its path blocked, and zero with nonreceptivity despite input 3. With solar input absent a lamp gives response 5 for the SAME illumination event; this scenario is allowed in expanded scope and excluded in solar-only scope. Both sources together give response 8 with contributions 3 and 5. Declared exercise is coherent when inputs correspond; the same populated bright input record with empty exercise is also coherent. The source/receiver bearers are distinct. These are analyst circuit assignments, not a witnessed actual episode, general optics, or substantial conservation.
